h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kochi

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kochi

items.pText: Kochi is a port city built around backwaters, and that shapes how a playground should be made here. Salt air, high humidity and one of the heaviest monsoons in India test every bolt and surface. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,110 km away, with galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic chosen for exactly these conditions.

We supply apartment builders in Kakkanad, Edappally and the suburbs, schools across Ernakulam district, and resorts and homestays that want a play corner for visiting families. The equipment goes from Vasai by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in the south. Since 2002 we have completed more than 15,000 installations across India, and the same process and warranty apply to a site in Kochi as to one near our factory.

richText.heading: Equipment that handles salt air and rain

c: The southwest monsoon reaches Kerala in early June and stays for months, and the northeast monsoon brings more rain later in the year. Bare mild steel rusts quickly in this climate. Our posts are galvanised, so the zinc layer protects the steel, and our slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded plastic that does not rust at all.

Near the backwaters or the sea, rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time. Lay the play area on a raised, well-drained base, because flat ground in Kochi can stay waterlogged after a heavy spell.

Apartment projects often want a single multi play station with a slide, a climber and a deck, which fits a podium or a garden strip. Schools ask for separate pieces for different age groups, such as swings, a see-saw and a climbing frame. Resorts usually look for a design that stands out.

Share photos taken during the rains if you can, because they show where water collects on the site.

Kochi's long wet season means moss and algae can grow on shaded decks and steps. Scrub these surfaces with mild soap and water every few weeks during the rains, and keep drains around the play area clear of leaves.

Check spring riders, swing hangers and bolts after each monsoon. Springs and bearings carry a one-year warranty and are the parts that see the most wear. Our after sales team on +91 738 530 0921 can help if anything needs replacing.

items.q: Is your playground equipment suitable for Kochi's coastal climate?
items.a: Yes. We use galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts, which resist rust in humid, salty air. Rinsing with fresh water now and then and following our maintenance steps helps the equipment last.

items.q: Do you deliver and install in Kochi?
items.a: Yes. We make everything at our factory in Vasai and send it to Kochi by road, where our installation team or a dealer in south India sets it up. Installation is easier outside the heaviest rain, so plan the date with that in mind.

items.q: What surface should go under the equipment in heavy rain?
items.a: A raised, well-drained base with rubber flooring works best. It cushions falls and dries faster than soil or grass. We can supply the rubber flooring with the equipment. Avoid loose sand on wet sites, as it holds water and washes away.

items.q: Can resorts get custom colours or designs?
items.a: Yes. Resorts can choose from more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades, and we customise designs on request. Share your idea and site photos and we will suggest what is possible. Resorts often pick colours that sit well with green lawns and water views.
